title: Remove expired feature flags
why: A structured feature-flag registry contains a literal expiry date that has passed, leaving temporary branching and rollout behavior in production beyond its reviewed lifetime.
suggestion: Remove the expired flag and its inactive branch, or extend the expiry through the project's normal review process.
limitations: Only feature-flags.json and feature_flags.json registries with flags, features, or experiments objects or arrays are inspected.
Expiry values must use a literal YYYY-MM-DD date in expiry, expires, expiresAt, or expires_at.
Dynamic registries and provider-side flag metadata are not available to offline analysis.
